title: Conducting density-sampled case-control studies using survey data with complex sampling designs: A simulation study.
authors: Li, Catherine X; Matthay, Ellicott C; Rowe, Christopher; Bradshaw, Patrick T; Ahern, Jennifer
one_liner_zh: 该文研究复杂抽样调查数据中密度抽样病例对照研究的统计方法，与无序蛋白互作及AI/物理模拟建模完全无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: Population-based surveys are possible sources from which to draw representative control data for case-control studies. However, these surveys involve complex sampling that could lead to biased estimates of measures of association if not properly accounted for in analyses. Approaches to incorporating complex-sampled controls in density-sampled case-control designs have not been examined. METHODS: We used a simulation study to evaluate the performance of different approaches to estimating incidence density ratios (IDR) from case-control studies with controls drawn from complex survey data using risk-set sampling. In simulated population data, we applied four survey sampling approaches, with varying survey sizes, and assessed the performance of four analysis methods for incorporating survey-based controls. RESULTS: Estimates of the IDR were unbiased for methods that conducted risk-set sampling with probability of selection proportional to survey weights. Estimates of the IDR were biased when sampling weights were not incorporated, or only included in regression modeling. The unbiased analysis methods performed comparably and produced estimates with variance comparable to biased methods. Variance increased and confidence interval coverage decreased as survey size decreased. CONCLUSIONS: Unbiased estimates are obtainable in risk-set sampled case-control studies using controls drawn from complex survey data when weights are properly incorporated.
abstract_zh: 目的：基于人群的调查是病例对照研究中获取代表性对照数据的可能来源。然而，这些调查涉及复杂抽样，若在分析中未适当考虑，可能导致关联度量的估计产生偏倚。目前尚未检验在密度抽样病例对照设计中纳入复杂抽样对照的方法。方法：我们使用模拟研究评估了不同方法在从复杂调查数据中通过风险集抽样选取对照的病例对照研究中估计发病率密度比（IDR）的表现。在模拟人群数据中，我们应用了四种调查抽样方法，并变化调查规模，评估了四种纳入基于调查对照的分析方法的表现。结果：对于采用风险集抽样且选择概率与调查权重成比例的方法，IDR估计无偏。当抽样权重未纳入或仅在回归建模中纳入时，IDR估计有偏。无偏分析方法表现相当，产生的估计方差与有偏方法相当。随着调查规模减小，方差增加，置信区间覆盖率降低。结论：在风险集抽样的病例对照研究中，当适当纳入权重时，使用来自复杂调查数据的对照可获得无偏估计。
